title: The Local-First Productivity & Git Stack: own your work

intro.headline: Build docs, manage projects, and host your code.
intro.subhead: AppFlowy, Forgejo, and Tale replace Notion, GitHub/GitLab, and Asana with local-first and self-hosted freedom.
